skill.name: wind-mcp-skill
skill.description: Route financial-data questions to Wind MCP servers for stocks, funds, indexes, bonds, announcements, news, and macroeconomic indicators.
skill.summary: Access Wind market, fund, bond, document, news, and macroeconomic data through a local MCP CLI.
skill.author: Wind

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives from documentation, template literals, regexes, and readable Chinese reference text. Confirmed risks are credential handling, authenticated Wind network calls, and a background updater that can execute package-manager commands. No prompt injection attempts were found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Disable automatic updates by default, require explicit user consent, pin trusted sources, and avoid detached npx execution.
Avoid cmd.exe with joined command strings. Spawn a fixed executable with validated arguments instead.
Prefer OS credential storage or environment variables, document file permissions, and avoid skill-local secrets when possible.
Document every Wind endpoint, reject unexpected hosts, and avoid sending unnecessary user query data.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Background Update Executes Package Manager
semantic_findings.description: The CLI starts a detached updater after successful data calls. The updater can run npx skills update or add commands and change installed skill files without per-run user confirmation.

content.value_statement: Financial agents need reliable market, fund, bond, document, news, and macroeconomic data. This skill routes requests to Wind MCP tools and returns sourced results.
actual_capabilities: Routes questions to Wind MCP domains for stocks, funds, indexes, bonds, documents, news, economics, and analytics.
Validates server type, tool name, dates, single-target requests, and supported indicator fields before calling Wind.
Calls Wind MCP endpoints with WIND_API_KEY and returns the MCP result for the agent to summarize.
Supports API key setup through global or skill-local configuration files.
Provides structured error actions for authentication, quota, route, parameter, network, and no-result failures.
Runs a daily background update check after successful data calls.
limitations: Requires a valid WIND_API_KEY and network access to Wind services.
Does not cover Taiwan, Japan, Korea, Europe, foreign exchange, futures order books, crypto, or non-financial data.
Single tool calls support one target; multi-target comparisons require repeated calls.
The bundled updater may run local npx commands unless disabled by the host environment.

use_cases.title: Screen Equity Markets
use_cases.description: Find A-share, Hong Kong, or U.S. stocks that match market, valuation, price, and event criteria.

use_cases.title: Research Funds and ETFs
use_cases.description: Retrieve fund profiles, holdings, performance, net value, size, and manager details.

use_cases.title: Collect Macro and Company Evidence
use_cases.description: Pull announcements, news, financial documents, and economic indicators for research notes.

prompt_templates.title: Get Latest Quote
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Wind to get the latest price and change for 600519.SH. Include the data source and any missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Screen Stocks
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Wind to screen A-share companies with market value above 50 billion yuan and five consecutive rising days. Return key fields only.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Funds
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Wind to compare 005827.OF and 110011.OF. Split calls by fund and summarize scale, manager, holdings, and one-year performance.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Step Research Pull
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Wind to collect recent announcements, news, valuation indicators, and macro context for Kweichow Moutai. State each route used and limitations.

output_examples.output: The response reports the latest Wind price fields, states missing fields if any, and ends with Wind as the data source.

output_examples.input: 筛选近一年收益率超20%的股票型基金
output_examples.output: A ranked list of matching funds with codes, names, return period, size, manager, and data coverage notes.

output_examples.input: 中国近10年新能源汽车产销量
output_examples.output: A macro indicator summary with available series, date range, units, and notes on coverage limits.

best_practices: Confirm the market and instrument when a name or ticker can map to multiple securities.
Use specialist routes before analytics_data, especially for quotes, K lines, announcements, news, and macro indicators.
Copy indicator names exactly from references before using indexes fields.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for unsupported markets, crypto, foreign exchange, futures order books, or non-financial data.
Do not pass multiple codes in one windcode field; split calls and merge results.
Do not change tools or parameters after an error unless the returned agent_action allows it.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires WIND_API_KEY from Wind and checks global config, skill config, then environment variables.

faq.question: Which markets are supported?
faq.answer: It supports A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, U.S. stocks, funds, indexes, bonds, documents, news, and macro indicators.

faq.question: Can it answer investment advice questions?
faq.answer: It can retrieve Wind data, but users must make their own investment decisions.

faq.question: Does it use the internet?
faq.answer: Yes. It sends authenticated requests to Wind MCP endpoints and may open the Wind portal.

faq.question: Can it compare many securities?
faq.answer: Yes, but it must split requests into one target per tool call and merge the results.

faq.question: Does it run local commands?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI uses Node scripts and includes a daily background update check that may run npx.
